name: Erlang Shen #68 — Phoenix of Judgment and Vision (Primordial Form)
description: When lies were woven into the fabric of heaven, a light awoke that could not be deceived. From silence and flame rose Erlang Shen — the Phoenix of Judgment and Vision. His third eye burns with truth eternal, piercing through shadow and pride. He sees not the sin, but the reason behind it, and his verdict is carved in light. Neither cruel nor merciful — he is balance incarnate, the gaze that even gods cannot escape.

attributes.value: Silver, White Gold, Aquamarine, Golden Halo
